title: Orunmila session footer, schema version 1
description: footer.json beside a session's logs, written at the closeout's end: the final line of each log by seq and hash, so the logs as they stood at the close can be checked. Provisional (Phase 4, slice K4, LD209; Q17, Q20).
$comment: brief v4 line 454 (the session footer containing the final hashes of all three logs); the fields are the agent's proposal (LD209, Q20). Unknown fields are allowed (brief v4 line 209).

record.description: Marks this file as a session footer.

raw.description: The raw log's last line at the closeout's end (the sweep's exited mark).

odu.description: The odù log's last line at the closeout's end, or null when no live odù log was written.

verdict.description: The verdict log's last line at the closeout's end, or null when no verdict log was written (the judge is off, or it failed, which the error log says).
verdict.$comment: brief v4 lines 453-454; agent's proposal (LD209), the line's shape since Phase 6 (Q34, LD262)

seq.$comment: agent's choice, LD209: as spec/hash-chain.md defines it

hash.$comment: agent's choice, LD209: as spec/hash-chain.md defines it
